description: A jurisdiction (SPEC 4, DEC-032). part_of is a list of sourced membership claims; several distinct parents are allowed, and how inheritance combines them is Phase 5 logic (DEC-041). A cycle or a self-reference is rejected by the cross-file check. authority_table is the sourced IRI of the jurisdiction's entry in the Publications Office country table (DEC-057); the IRI takes one fixed form and a missing source is rejected.

authority_table.description: The jurisdiction's entry in the Publications Office country table: its IRI (http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/country/ and the three-letter code), the source it was read from and the certainty (DEC-057).
